part.text:
The `join_size` failure is pre-existing (fails identically on the unmodified baseline — it's an allocation-counting test sensitive to the toolchain, unrelated to this change).

Fix implemented:

- `tokio/src/net/udp.rs` — added `impl UnwindSafe for UdpSocket {}` and `impl RefUnwindSafe for UdpSocket {}` (tokio/src/net/udp.rs:127-129), addressing the reported issue.
- `tokio/src/net/tcp/listener.rs`, `tcp/stream.rs`, `unix/{datagram/socket,listener,stream}.rs` — added the same `UnwindSafe`/`RefUnwindSafe` impls for `TcpListener`, `TcpStream`, `UnixDatagram`, `UnixListener`, `UnixStream`, matching the tree's `net_types_unwind.rs` test which requires all net types to be unwind-safe.

Verification: `cargo test -p tokio --features full --test net_types_unwind --test udp --test async_send_sync` all pass; the rest of the tokio test suite shows no new failures.
